title: 第534章 钓鱼修行第二天的局势第533章 提升肉身晚上欺负回来
slug: 八年质子归京岂知天下已刻吾名
lines: 黎清月踏入凤血仙池，自然没有任何阻挡。
随着她轻盈的身姿没入那赤红如血仙池深处，整个凤血仙池四周的区域，瞬间被一股无形的力量笼罩，化作了一片绝对的禁地。
凤灵儿这里，则是小心翼翼地跟随着一同前去。
显然，她与黎清月同为女子，对于这凤血仙池之中的造化有着极深的感悟，可以为黎清月引路。
同时，这对于她而言。
也是一场机缘。
她体内的真凤血脉之力，可以相助黎清月开启这仙池之中的问道试炼。
否则，就算黎清月在强大，没有真凤一族的血脉之力，也难以将其开启。
孟尘没有去打扰她们，只是席地而坐，随手从旁边折下一根枯枝作为鱼竿，以仙力为丝线，招呼凤七坐下，直接垂钓起鱼来。
这仙山之下，流淌有仙河贯穿。
万丈之下，赤霞蒸腾，龙鱼穿梭！
这里，正是垂钓的好地方。
“钓鱼？”
凤七有些发懵，自然不敢拒绝，甚至倍感荣幸。
他心中无比清楚，能够与孟尘这样的人哪怕只是坐在一起，便是一种天大的修行。
就这样，黎清月与凤灵儿进入凤血仙池之中。
而孟尘则与凤七钓鱼，这一切都很安逸。
不过。
与此同时。
这第二层天，凤族所在的这片大地之外，却是进行着大动作。
无数第二层天之上的势力，纷纷有强者走出。
那些半只脚踏入黄土之中，早已陷入沉眠的老祖，也都纷纷醒来。
其中不乏有与凤七这个仙王，同属于一个时代的老怪物。
甚至比之还要古老的存在，也不是没有。
当然，他们的最高修为，也只是仙王之境，没有一个仙帝。
这第二层天，虽然没有一位仙帝，但曾经却走出过不少仙帝人物。
不过那些人物，大多都与他们这第二层天的底蕴断联了，有的早已在仙界的岁月之中陨灭，有的则斩去了身后尘念，不问琐事。
有的，则彻底失踪在了仙界之中。
没有人知道，他们究竟去了哪里，毕竟这仙界实在是太浩瀚了，修士无数，有些人外出历练，便再也没有回来了。
不过，这些曾经诞生过仙帝的势力，皆留有仙帝底蕴。
这些势力走出的同时，目标纷纷落在了凤族之上，自然也将各自的仙帝底蕴带出。
他们的目的，自然只有一个，那就是想要看一看，凤族究竟带回了一个怎样的存在。
这些第二层天的势力，除却第二天仅有的家族势力外，还有与凤族一样的仙界底蕴，加起来足有数百个势力，浩浩荡荡朝着凤族所在的大陆而来。
外界虽动荡。
在孟尘眼中，却泛不出丝毫波澜。
他这里，依旧稳坐如山，手中的枯枝鱼竿轻轻晃动，随手一提，便有一条龙鱼被提了上来。
短短一会，他这里已然钓上来不少。
反观凤七这位凤族的老祖，到现在也没有一条鱼儿上钩，赤裸裸的空军！
凤七也好一阵尴尬。
他这里，虽说不专于此事，但这对于他一个仙王而言，自然不算什么难事，甚至可以说手拿把掐。
可偏偏就是如此奇怪，他这么半天，居然连一条都没有钓上来。
如果不是孟尘在这里，他早气的跳脚，直接开始出手炸鱼了。
仙王出手，哪怕这下方是一条仙河，他也可以轻松炼干。
content_en:
When Li Qingyue stepped into the Phoenix Blood Immortal Pond, there was naturally no obstacle.
As her light figure sank into the depths of the crimson Blood Immortal Pond, the entire area around the Phoenix Blood Immortal Pond was instantly enveloped by an invisible force and turned into an absolute forbidden land.
Feng Ling'er followed cautiously.
Obviously, she and Li Qingyue are both women, and they have a deep understanding of the creation in this Phoenix Blood Immortal Pond, and can guide Li Qingyue.
At the same time, this is for her.
It's also an opportunity.
The power of the True Phoenix bloodline in her body can help Li Qingyue start the questioning trial in this fairy pond.
Otherwise, even if Li Qingyue is strong, it will be difficult to open it without the blood power of the Zhenfeng clan.
Meng Chen didn't bother them, just sat on the ground, casually broke off a dead branch from the side and used it as a fishing rod, used the immortal power as the thread, asked Feng Qi to sit down, and started fishing directly.
Under this fairy mountain, there is a fairy river flowing through it.
Beneath the sky, red clouds are steaming, and arowanas are flying!
Here is a good place for fishing.
"Fishing?"
Feng Qi was a little confused, so naturally she didn't dare to refuse, and she even felt honored.
He knew very well that being able to sit together with someone like Meng Chen was a huge accomplishment.
In this way, Li Qingyue and Feng Ling'er entered the Phoenix Blood Immortal Pond.
While Meng Chen was fishing with Feng Qi, everything was very comfortable.
but.
at the same time.
On this second level of heaven, outside the land where the Phoenix Clan is located, big actions are taking place.
From countless forces on the second level of heaven, strong men have stepped out one after another.
The ancestors who had already fallen asleep with half their feet in the loess also woke up one after another.
Among them are many old monsters who belong to the same era as the Immortal King Feng Qi.
There are even existences older than this.
Of course, their highest level of cultivation is only the realm of Immortal Kings, and there is no Immortal Emperor.
Although there is no Immortal Emperor in this second heaven, there have been many Immortal Emperors in the past.
However, most of those characters have been disconnected from their background in the second heaven. Some have already perished in the years of the fairy world, while others have cut off their earthly thoughts behind them and do not care about trivial matters.
Some have completely disappeared into the fairy world.
No one knows where they went. After all, this immortal world is too vast. There are countless monks. Some of them went out to practice and never came back.
However, these forces that have given birth to Immortal Emperors all have Immortal Emperor heritage.
When these forces stepped out, their targets fell on the Phoenix Clan, and naturally they also brought out their respective Immortal Emperor background.
Naturally, they have only one purpose, and that is to see what kind of existence the Phoenix Clan has brought back.
These forces in the second heaven, in addition to the only family forces on the second day, also have the same fairyland background as the Feng Clan. In total, there are hundreds of forces, heading towards the mainland where the Feng Clan is located.
Although the outside world is turbulent.
In Meng Chen's eyes, there was no trace of emotion.
Here, he was still sitting as firmly as a mountain, with the dead branch fishing rod in his hand shaking slightly, and with a casual lift, an arowana was lifted up.
In just a short while, he had already caught a lot of fish here.
On the other hand, Feng Qi, the ancestor of the Feng Clan, has not taken the bait so far. The naked air force!
Feng Qi felt embarrassed for a while.
Although he is not specialized in this matter, it is naturally not a difficult task for him as an Immortal King, and he can even handle it with his hands.
But it was so strange that he didn't catch even one for such a long time.
If Meng Chen hadn't been here, he would have jumped out of anger and started frying fish.
If the Immortal King takes action, even if there is an Immortal River below, he can easily refine it.
